html:
G'oya

Har bir to'lovdan ikkita son olamiz: yil va chorak. Keyin shu juftlik bo'yicha guruhlab, summani qo'shamiz. Yilni guruhdan chiqarib bo'lmaydi, aks holda 2023 va 2024 yillarning 1-choragi bitta qatorga qo'shilib ketadi.

Yechim

PostgreSQL'da chorakni EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM ...) tayyor beradi. EXTRACT NUMERIC qaytaradi, ::int bilan butun son qilamiz:

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM paid_on)::int AS year,
       EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM paid_on)::int AS quarter,
       SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM payments
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY year, quarter

SQLite'da chorak funksiyasi yo'q, uni oydan hisoblaymiz. Butun sonlarni bo'lishda kasr qismi tashlanadi, shuning uchun (oy + 2) / 3 1, 2, 3-oylar uchun 1, 4, 5, 6-oylar uchun 2 va hokazo beradi:

Faqat SQLiteSELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', paid_on) AS INTEGER) AS year,
       (CAST(strftime('%m', paid_on) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter,
       SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM payments
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY year, quarter

Tuzoqlar

Formulani chegaradagi oylarda tekshiring. oy / 3 + 1 yanvar va fevralda to'g'ri ishlaydi, lekin mart uchun 3 / 3 + 1 = 2 beradi. Namunadagi 2024-03-31 dagi to'lov 2-chorakka o'tib ketadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(paid_on AS TEXT), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
       CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(paid_on AS TEXT), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) / 3 + 1 AS quarter,
       SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM payments
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY year, quarter

oy / 4 + 1 esa iyul va avgustni 2-chorak deb hisoblaydi. Yaxshi formula uchun 3, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10-oylarni sinab ko'rish kifoya.

Natijani tushum bo'yicha saralamang: so'ralgan tartib yil va chorak bo'yicha.

Boshqa yo'l

Sanani matnga aylantirsangiz, ikkala bazada 2024-03-31 chiqadi: yil birinchi 4 belgida, oy 6- va 7-belgida. Bu so'rov ikkala bazada ishlaydi:

SELECT CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(paid_on AS TEXT), 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
       (CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(paid_on AS TEXT), 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3 AS quarter,
       SUM(amount) AS revenue
FROM payments
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY year, quarter
